settings.rescale_source: E187 (P2.28, compare-lead), ~/commute-agents/compare-lead/experiments/size_matched/results/qwen/<pair>/readings.json .cells: c = mean |δW| of the smaller side / mean of the larger side over seeds 0-2 (size_matched/qwen.py cells), one scalar on every matrix of each larger-side state; the smaller side is read at saved size only
settings.n_rows_source: each arm's own row set as the library built it, 128 rows x 256 tokens (share_reading.rows_of; both gold arms on gold's rows, qwen_library_share/run.py ROWSET)
settings.n_fit_source: run 1's split (E216 settings n_fit): maps fitted on rows 0-63 (16,384 positions), KL read on rows 64-127 (16,384). On a built side the rows pack the trained cue sequences in passes, so the same sequences recur in both halves: the read half is held-out positions, not held-out items
settings.s_tol_source: run 1's output-only bar (E216 s_tol); run 1 measured 1 - S = 2.4e-8 on maths rows (results/S/output_only.json), so the bar sits 4e4 x above the measured floor
settings.zero_kl_source: run 1 (E216 zero_kl); run 1 measured KL(F||M) = 0 exactly for F = M (results/S/do_nothing.json)
settings.s_floor_factor_source: run 1 (E216): 'no change' when KL(F||M) <= 100 x the row set's do-nothing KL(F||H); run 1's do-nothing KL(F||H) was 3.5e-9 on maths rows (floor 3.5e-7), measured again per row set here in the same job
settings.s_draw_source: run 1's S_random: Gaussian draw 0 (share_reading.gaussian, seed null_seed(0, site)) scaled to the state's per-matrix norms; the same direction for every state, as in run 1
settings.smallest_gap_source: the 67M's smallest reuse-minus-new S gap on a built pair (E197, 0.005-0.011; plan appendix 'S gap'), the smallest gap that would carry the 67M's reading over; it is above run 1's seed spread (0.0041) and resolves at n 3: 0.005 / (0.0041 / sqrt 3) = 2.1 standard errors (fleet/card's bar is 2; the spread itself, 0.0041, gives 1.73)
settings.spread_source: run 1's measured seed sd of S, the largest over its three runs (results/summary.json per_arm.F.S_seed_sd = 0.004095, n 2; R 0.00066, N 0.0035), rounded up. Run 2 reports each side's own seed sd (n 3) beside it; the rule's bar is smallest_gap

measurement.S: Run 1's held-model reading (reading 3), code commute.qwen_held.Held (moved from run.py, arithmetic unchanged; Grams held on the host between reads, store='cpu', an exact copy): M = W0, F = W0 + δW (196 linear matrices). At each layer's o_proj and down_proj, A = C G^+ fitted on rows 0-63 of the arm's row set; S = 1 - KL(F||H) / KL(F||M), mean per position over rows 64-127; 'no change' (None) when KL(F||M) <= the row set's floor
measurement.S_random: Per state read, the Gaussian change of settings.s_draw at that state's per-matrix norms, read for S by the same code on the same rows; for a rescaled read the same Gaussian times c
measurement.rescaled: Each state of the larger side at that save (settings.rescale) multiplied by c on every matrix and read again ('<key>_c'); the smaller side keeps its saved-size S
measurement.gap: Per pair, save and seed: S(reuse side) - S(new side). 'saved': both at saved size. 'matched': the larger side's S replaced by its rescaled S. Seeds are paired by seed number (seed s of one side with seed s of the other), as P3.9's gaps were (qwen_library_share/run.py summarise)

blind_to.S: Whether F's units are M's re-weighted or new directions M's units span on 16,384 positions (2.7 fit positions per MLP input, run 1's flag 5); the random change shares the rows and fit size. Attention-pattern changes enter only through F's write at o_proj. On a built side the read half repeats the fit half's cue sequences, so S there is read on the trained text itself
blind_to.gap: Which side's units change; a gap from a size difference is read only through the rescaled read, which E205 found lowers S on the 67M (0.0006-0.030), so it shrinks only the larger side

measurement.positive_control: The pod's first state's change at o_proj and down_proj only, which reading 3 expresses exactly: S >= 0.999 (run 1 read 1 - 2.4e-8)
measurement.noise_floor: Run 1's seed sd of S (settings.spread, 0.0041), under the rule's bar (settings.smallest_gap, 0.005); each row set's do-nothing KL(F||H) (H's own fit noise), which sets the 'no change' floor; each side's own seed sd over 3 seeds, reported

controls_stop_on_miss.S_do_nothing: Before any state of a row set: F = M reads KL(F||M) <= 1e-9 per position and S 'no change' (None) (control/<rowset>_do_nothing.json)
controls_stop_on_miss.S_output_only: Before the pod's first state is read: that state's o_proj and down_proj change alone reads S >= 0.999 (control/output_only.json)
controls_stop_on_miss.sha256: Each fetched state matches the library's recorded sha256 (library_states.fetch raises otherwise)
controls_stop_on_miss.rows: Each row set is 128 x 256 tokens

pod_order.copy_cipher: cipher (larger at both saves) last s0-2, 5x s0-2, then copy last s0-2, 5x s0-2; rows cipher then copy
pod_order.facts: invented (larger at both saves), then known; rows invented then known
pod_order.gold: gold_shuf (larger at last), then gold (larger at 5x); one row set, gold's
pod_order.counts: per pod 12 states (2 sides x 3 seeds x 2 saves; run2.order); 36 S reads (12 at saved size, 12 random, 6 rescaled, 6 rescaled random; run2.names) plus 3 control reads (2 for gold: one row set)

expected.S_do_nothing: KL(F||M) 0 exactly; KL(F||H) above 0 only by H's fit noise, run 1 read 3.5e-9 on maths rows; on the library's packed rows (repeated sequences, so more near-collinear units) up to 1e-7 would not surprise
expected.S_states: Between 0.95 and 0.999 at saved size: run 1 read 0.977-0.997 on the E167 states (results/summary.json), the 67M's reading 3 0.95-0.998 on fine-tunes (E205). No prior on the library's rows
expected.S_random: About 0.75-0.85 when read (run 1: 0.79-0.82 at KL(F||M) 1e-5 to 2.5e-5 on maths rows). A Gaussian's KL scales roughly with its norm squared, so at the smallest states (copy 5x, |δW| 0.17-0.22; cipher 5x times c 0.38, ~0.19) it is ~1e-6, near the 'no change' floor (~3.5e-7 if the library rows' do-nothing reads as run 1's): those random references may read 'no change', reported as such; the rule does not read S_random
expected.S_rescaled: Each rescaled state's S lower than its saved S by 0.0006-0.03 (E205, 67M: every state shrunk by a tenth or more lost S). So the matched gap widens where the new side is larger (copy_cipher, facts at both saves; gold at last) and narrows on gold at 5x (the reuse side, gold, is the larger)
expected.gaps: 67M (E197): reuse side above by 0.005-0.011 on built pairs, beyond seed sd; Qwen has no prior. Rival A: every seed's gap above 0.005 at both saves, saved size and size-matched, on all three pairs; rival B: no pair does
expected.seed_sd: Each side's seed sd of S under ~0.005 (run 1's largest 0.0041 at n 2)
expected.time: Per pod: run 1 measured ~26 s per S read on an H100 including the state's load and the Gaussian draw (stage 2: 12 reads in 5 min 14 s, results/run_pod.log 23:20:51-23:26:05); 39 reads x 26 s = 17 min, plus Grams and pinv 14 s per row set (run 1), ~1-2 s more a read for copying the host-held Grams back. Fetch: 12 states x 5,637,164,512 B = 67.6 GB at W&B's 30-45 MB/s on a pod = 25-38 min; each state's 2-4 reads (52-104 s) are shorter than its fetch (125-188 s), so a pod is fetch-bound: ~25-38 min after the first state's fetch starts, plus set-up (~10-15 min): ~40-55 min a pod on one H100, three pods in parallel; ~$3-4 a pod at $3.99/h, ~$10-12 in all

gap.rule: summary2.gap_rule per pair, save and kind ('saved', 'matched'), on the three seeds' gaps: 'reuse above' if every gap > 0.005; 'new above' if every gap < -0.005; 'within bar' if every |gap| <= 0.005 or the gaps have both signs; 'mixed' otherwise; 'unreadable' if fewer than 3 gaps or any S of the cell reads 'no change' or is not finite. Rounded to 9 places
gap.pair: summary2.pair_outcome over the pair's four rules (2 saves x saved, matched): 'separates' if all four read 'reuse above'; 'reversed' if all four 'new above'; 'unreadable' if any is; else 'does not separate'
gap.outcome: summary2.outcome over the three pairs: 'rival A' if every pair separates; 'rival B' if no pair separates and none is unreadable (a 'reversed' pair counts here, and is announced as a reversal of the 67M's order); 'neither' otherwise (some pairs separate, or one is unreadable)

rules.S_random: Reported beside each read; no rule (run 1 already found every E167 state 0.17-0.19 above its random change)
